highlights: Philips USB-C Hub 4-USB 3.0 Port + USB-C PD 60W Type-C Hub Adapter - SWR1607K/93
USB C is expanded to four USB 3.0 and PD charging ports. USB 3.0 supports 5Gbps transfer rate, and the PD charging port supports up to 60W charging.
USB-C socket hub expands to 5-port mini hub.
powered by Multiple USB-C and USB-A ports
Multiple USB-C and USB-A ports allow you to expand your MacBook / MacBook Pro or other USB-C enabled devices to connect to all the USB devices you need while charging via a USB-C charger.
